about:
Calmont Wire & Cable was founded in 1958 in Santa Ana, California, by Bill Chilcote, who started the company with an extruder producing tubing for the Hula Hoop craze. The privately held firm quickly pivoted to aerospace and military markets, solving wire and cable challenges for emerging technologies.

Today, Calmont designs, manufactures, and tests custom wire and cable from its southern California facilities, offering on-demand inventory and reverse-engineered replacement cables for medical device repair. The company handles prototyping, short runs, and long runs, with capabilities spanning custom engineering, sterilization-resistant designs, and solutions for extreme environments such as cryogenics and space.

Calmont serves medical (including implants, robotics, and surgical devices), aerospace (Apollo, Space Shuttle, Hubble Telescope), military and defense, robotics, communications, and testing and measurement industries. Its customer base ranges from start-ups developing novel prototypes to established programs requiring high-reliability interconnects.

The company emphasizes accessibility—customers speak directly with wire and cable experts—and a culture of continuous improvement that has yielded a 99.4% customer acceptance rate. Calmont positions itself as a problem-solving partner willing to tackle difficult, never-been-run jobs, with a mission to bring manufacturing back to the United States.
